verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Square's Payments, Payouts, Invoices, and Subscriptions APIs, but none of it documents seller-onboarding (e.g., OAuth/sub-merchant creation) or payment-splitting/marketplace-fee functionality needed to build a multi-seller marketplace with split payouts. The Payouts API here appears to cover Square's own standard payouts to a single account, not multi-party split disbursement.
